case_title.reason: Title matches the judgment's caption, Prem Kumar Gulati v. State of Haryana and another.

number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants whose liability is decided: Mahender Singh and Prem Kumar Gulati.

accused_gender.reason: The two accused whose liability is decided are both male.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the accused.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is stated.

accused_occupation.reason: Defence statement says the husband was working at a flour mill; the value attributes this correctly.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment mentions a 2001 case compromised via panchayat but states no prior conviction; Not stated is supported.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is a married woman, Rajni, referred to as female throughout.

victim_age.reason: Dying declaration records the victim as aged 28 years.

victim_caste.reason: No caste of the victim is stated.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Husband, brother-in-law, and alleged illicit relations and prior disputes are all described in the judgment.

offence_category.reason: Charged under s.302 IPC, with the death of the victim by burning.

statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment states s.302/498-A read with s.34, Indian Penal Code.

weapon.reason: Kerosene oil poured and set alight is the method described.

evidence_type.reason: Dying declaration, medical, father's and brother's testimony, investigation evidence and defence child witness all appear.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Repeated dowry harassment, prior panchayat-settled incidents, and no attempt made to extinguish the fire (as recorded in the dying declaration and testimony)
aggravating_circumstances.quote: None made attempt to extinguish fire.
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Court records aggravating facts such as dowry harassment and no attempt to extinguish the fire, so 'None noted' understates them.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts about the accused are noted by the court.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted all three; life and Rs.5,000 under s.302, one year RI and Rs.500 under s.498A, each accused.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeal and upheld the trial judgment; date discrepancy is accurately flagged.

final_outcome.quote: dismiss Criminal Appeal No. 1423 of 2009 and uphold the conviction of Mahender Singh
final_outcome.reason: Single value hides that the brother-in-law was acquitted while the main accused was convicted.

offence_finally_established.reason: Main accused's conviction upheld; brother-in-law acquitted, as the value states.

imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment for the main accused under s.302 is the final sentence type.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: 1 (one year RI under s.498A, which stands with the upheld conviction)
imprisonment_years.quote: rigorous imprisonment for one year and fine of Rs. 500/-under Section 498A
imprisonment_years.reason: Null ignores the one-year RI under s.498A that accompanied the upheld conviction.

fine_rs.quote: imposed a fine of Rs.5,000/-under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC
fine_rs.reason: Only the s.302 fine is given; the Rs.500 fine under s.498A was also imposed and upheld.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Summary should avoid pronouns for the accused, e.g. 'the husband' rather than 'he' and 'him'
neutral_facts.quote: she quarrelled with him over it, and that after drinking liquor he beat her
neutral_facts.reason: Summary is otherwise accurate and within length, but uses gender pronouns ('him', 'he') for the accused husband.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory maximum or minimum punishment.

attempt_completion.reason: Victim died from the burns, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death from about 50% ante-mortem burns and superficial deep burns across the body are both recorded.

number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged (s.302 and s.498A, each r/w s.34); conviction of the main accused upheld on both.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is described.

premeditation_planning.reason: The court does not discuss premeditation or planning.

motive.reason: Alleged motive of illicit relationship and dowry harassment is marked alleged, and the court did not separately decide it.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on the truthful and reliable dying declaration and found sufficient evidence against the main accused.

witness_credibility.reason: Court accepted the dying declaration, found no corroboration against brother-in-law, and did not assess the child witness.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is noted by the court.

custody_duration.reason: No custody period is stated in the judgment.

bail_history.reason: No bail history is stated in the judgment.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date, trial judgment, HC date (with header discrepancy) and SC date all match the judgment.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel for the appellants and the State match the judgment's listing.

investigation_status.reason: FIR based on dying declaration, investigation completed, only main accused arraigned, others added under s.319, trial completed.

procedural_irregularity.quote: Prem Kumar Gulati and Smt. Bimla alias Nirmla were summoned to face trial along with other accused Mahender, as additional accused, by invoking the provisions of Section 319
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court describes the s.319 addition but does not flag it as a lapse; 'None noted' is the supported value.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction of all three, HC dismissal, SC upholding main accused's conviction and acquitting brother-in-law, all match.

prosecution_argument.reason: Dying declaration sufficiency, narrative form citing Shariff, father's reliability and same-building residence all match the State's arguments.

defence_argument.reason: Innocence of brother-in-law, vague dying declaration, no eyewitness, child witness disbelief and past-litigation motive are all raised.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Dying declaration as sole basis subject to close scrutiny, no q&a requirement, and benefit of doubt for co-accused match the reasoning.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Godhu, K. Ramachandra Reddy, Kali Ram, Khushal Rao, Harbans Singh, Tapinder Singh and Lallubhai are all relied on by the court.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court gives no sentencing rationale; Not applicable is supported.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court weighs no mitigating factors itself.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court weighs no aggravating factors itself in sentencing.

other_sentence_order.reason: Brother-in-law ordered released forthwith and main accused's appeal dismissed, as stated.
